title: Server-admin grant on /api/admin/users/:id/permissions requires reqGrafanaAdmin, not just a permission check
answers: Can a regular admin with users:permissions:update grant isGrafanaAdmin?
Why does PUT /api/admin/users/:id/permissions still 403 for org admins with the right permission?
How is granting Grafana server-admin status protected?
body:
Setting isGrafanaAdmin via PUT /api/admin/users/:id/permissions must remain gated by the reqGrafanaAdmin middleware in addition to the ActionUsersPermissionsUpdate permission check.
Enforced at: pkg/api/api.go, adminUserRoute.Put("/:id/permissions", userUIDResolver, reqGrafanaAdmin, authorizeInOrg(ac.UseGlobalOrSingleOrg(hs.Cfg), ac.EvalPermission(ac.ActionUsersPermissionsUpdate, userIDScope)), ...).
If reqGrafanaAdmin is removed or reordered out, an org Admin (single- or multi-org) holding only the permissions:update action could grant server-admin rights to a user, escalating privileges outside org scope.
Regression covered by TestAdminUsersAuthorization_OrgAdminCannotGrantServerAdmin in pkg/api/admin_users_test.go, run for both single-org and multi-org configs.
